holdout.gold_source: Compiled read-only SQLite SQL results; independently checked against Python refund source-row oracle and two marketing event-ledger oracles.

container.filesystem: source copied to /tmp/project; tests and SQLite temp files on tmpfs

environment_notes: An initial no-env container run could not import 5 test modules; each reported missing LLM_API_KEY, LLM_BASE_URL, and LLM_MODEL. It was rerun with shell-only dummy values, without mounting .env.
TestClient tests issue in-process HTTP requests only. Network mode none prevents external API access.
No test requires PostgreSQL; no Compose service or persistent data was started.

commands.docker_invocation: docker run --rm --network none --tmpfs /tmp:rw,exec,size=2g -e PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 -e LLM_API_KEY=offline-test-key -e LLM_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:1/v1 -e LLM_MODEL=offline-no-model --mount "type=bind,source=E:\job\insightpilot,target=/workspace" insightpilot-api-probe:latest python -c "import pathlib,shutil,subprocess,sys; src=pathlib.Path('/workspace'); dst=pathlib.Path('/tmp/project'); dst.mkdir(); names=('insightpilot','data','evals','reports','docs','tests','scripts'); [shutil.copytree(src/name,dst/name) for name in names]; [shutil.copy2(src/name,dst/name) for name in ('README.md','requirements.txt')]; sys.exit(subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','unittest','discover','-s','tests','-q'],cwd=dst).returncode)"

host_comparison.cause: TestClient startup blocks in asyncio socket.socketpair initialization before request handling.

mount_performance_attempt.diagnosis: Both failures disappeared when source and temporary SQLite files ran on container tmpfs, consistent with slow Windows bind-mounted SQLite I/O; no product code change was made for them.

limitations: v3 questions and gold are new, but v3 uses the same fixed synthetic dataset fingerprint and seed as v2.
24 cases provide contract coverage only; they do not estimate model quality, production accuracy, or population-level generalization.
Zero exact normalized prompt overlap does not prove semantic non-overlap.
